svg.title: Metacognition in large language models: a level-structured taxonomy
svg.desc: A nested taxonomy panel. The masthead carries a hierarchical relation diagram linking L0 cognitive execution, L1 monitoring and control, and L2 learning. Below it, each level band is a rounded container holding the chapter that belongs to it; every chapter branches into its sub-questions, each of which carries a compact citation string of its representative works, prefixed by evidence tier D (primary metacognitive study), A (adjacent or enabling), B (boundary), or S (survey synthesis). The bands run from theoretical foundations through the L0-L2 framework, Level 1 representation, Level 1 regulation, cross-level evaluation, Level 2 learning, and the recursive extension, ending in research gaps.
svg.text: Observe L0 cognition; choose when / what / how much to regulate
Evaluation spans levels: signal validity | realized decision utility | compute-matched ΔU1 (L1→L0) | improvement gain ΔU2 (L2→L1)
RSI is a recursive extension, not Level 3.
